From 70685c291ef82269180758130394ecdc4496b52c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Darrick J. Wong" <djwong@kernel.org>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 14:01:57 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] xfs: don't irele after failing to iget in
 xfs_attri_recover_work

xlog_recovery_iget* never set @ip to a valid pointer if they return
an error, so this irele will walk off a dangling pointer.  Fix that.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v6.10
Fixes: ae673f534a3097 ("xfs: record inode generation in xattr update log intent items")
Signed-off-by: Darrick J. Wong <djwong@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Long Li <leo.lilong@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>
Reviewed-by: Carlos Maiolino <cmaiolino@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Carlos Maiolino <cem@kernel.org>

diff --git a/fs/xfs/xfs_attr_item.c b/fs/xfs/xfs_attr_item.c
index 82324f42537b..deab14f31b38 100644
--- a/fs/xfs/xfs_attr_item.c
+++ b/fs/xfs/xfs_attr_item.c
@@ -653,7 +653,6 @@ xfs_attri_recover_work(
 		break;
 	}
 	if (error) {
-		xfs_irele(ip);
 		XFS_CORRUPTION_ERROR(__func__, XFS_ERRLEVEL_LOW, mp, attrp,
 				sizeof(*attrp));
 		return ERR_PTR(-EFSCORRUPTED);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file, `fs/xfs/xfs_attr_item.c`, to fix a bug in function `xfs_attri_recover_work`. 

**Modification in `fs/xfs/xfs_attr_item.c`:**  
Removed the `xfs_irele(ip)` call in the error path after a failed `xlog_recovery_iget` call. The removal prevents a reference count decrement on a dangling pointer, as the `iget` functions do not set `ip` to a valid pointer on error.

**Relationship:**  
The change directly addresses the bug where an invalid pointer could be passed to `xfs_irele`, causing undefined behavior. By removing the erroneous call, the error handling path now correctly returns an error without attempting to release an uninitialized or invalid inode reference.
